mapper.select: /* selectSemstrCombo */ SELECT A.SEMSTR_SE_CD , B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE FROM AFA310 A JOIN SDA420 B ON A.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAC100 C ON C.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SEMSTR_SE_CD' AND C.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.SEMSTR_SE_CD WHERE A.USE_YN = 'Y'

/* isry.subms.stats.operprfmnc.mapper.OperPrfmncMapper - selectNmprPreconList[Lee SangHoon] */
SELECT T3.BIZ_YR -- 사업연도 ,T.PVSN_RESRCE_NM -- 제공자원명 ,T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM ,T4.INST_NM -- 기관명 ,T1.* FROM SDA100 T JOIN (SELECT A.RESRCE_NO -- 자원번호 , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_BGNG_YMD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(C.PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_END_YMD ,COUNT(DISTINCT A.CASE_MNG_NO) AS TOT_PTCPTN_NOPE -- 재적인원 ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.CASE_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} THEN 1 END) AS NEW_NOPE -- 신규인원 ,COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN B.CASE_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} THEN 1 END) AS TRMN_NOPE -- 종결인원 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('01') THEN 1 END) AS ATEND_NOPE -- 출석 수 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('02') THEN 1 END) AS ABSNC_NOPE -- 결석 수 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('03') THEN 1 END) AS LATEN_NOPE -- 지각 수 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('04') THEN 1 END) AS LRLY_NOPE -- 조퇴 수 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('05') THEN 1 END) AS GOOUT_NOPE -- 외출 수 ,COUNT(CASE WHEN A.ATNC_SE_CD IN ('06', '07', '08', '09', '10') THEN 1 END) AS ETC_NOPE -- 기타 수 ,(SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT LCTRE_YMD) FROM SDA320 WHERE RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO AND LCTRE_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD}) AS CLASSCNT_NOPE -- 수업일수 FROM SEB530 A LEFT JOIN SEB100 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SDA100 C ON C.RESRCE_NO = A.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN AFA310 D ON D.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = C.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND A.PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN D.BGNG_YMD AND D.END_YMD AND D.USE_YN = 'Y'
WHERE 1=1 AND A.PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN #{BGNG_YMD} AND #{END_YMD} AND D.SEMSTR_SE_CD LIKE #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} || '%'
GROUP BY A.RESRCE_NO, C.PVSN_BGNG_YMD, C.PVSN_END_YMD ) T1 ON T1.RESRCE_NO = T.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SDA420 T2 ON T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 T3 ON T3.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T2.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 T4 ON T4.INST_NO = T.RSFR_INST_NO
WHERE 1=1 AND T.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND T.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T4.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T3.BIZ_YR = #{BIZ_YR} AND T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND T4.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND T.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
ORDER BY T3.BIZ_YR DESC, T4.INST_NO, T2.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO

/* selectNmprAchivRateList(인원목표달성현황) - Lee Hye Sun */ SELECT F.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR /*사업연도*/ , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM /*제공자원명*/ , B.RESRCE_NO AS RESRCE_NO /*자원번호*/ , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_BGNG_YMD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(B.PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_END_YMD , B.UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE AS GOAL_NMPR /*이용정원*/ , K.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM /*서비스실행사업명*/ , K.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO /*서비스실행사업번호*/ , G.INST_NO AS INST_NO /*기관번호*/ , G.INST_NM AS OPER_INST_NM /*기관명*/ , H.SEMSTR_SE_CD AS SEMSTR_SE_CD /*학기구분코드*/ , G.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD /*단위업무구분코드*/ , COUNT(A.CASE_MNG_NO) AS SRVCTRPR /*서비스제공대상자수*/ , (SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SEMSTR_SE_CD' AND CMMNS_CD_VALUE = H.SEMSTR_SE_CD) AS SEMSTR_SE /*학기구분코드*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN (D.CASE_BGNG_YMD BETWEEN H.BGNG_YMD AND H.END_YMD) OR (D.CASE_TRMN_YMD BETWEEN H.BGNG_YMD AND H.END_YMD) THEN A.SRVC_PVSN_NO END) AS TOT_PTCPTN_NOPE /*재적*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN E.CASE_TRMN_YMD BETWEEN H.BGNG_YMD AND H.END_YMD AND E.TRMN_SE_CD = '10' THEN D.CASE_MNG_NO END) AS FNSH /*수료*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY') - NVL(TO_CHAR(F.BIZ_YR), TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY')) >= 1 THEN NVL(J.INDV_IDNTFC_NO, I.TRPR_INFO_NO) END) AS DPCN_PTCPTN /*중복참여율*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SE_CD = '04' AND E.TRMN_CS_SE_CD = '040' THEN D.CASE_MNG_NO END) AS MDSTRM_FAILR /*중도포기*/ , COUNT(CASE WHEN E.TRMN_SE_CD = '04' AND E.TRMN_CS_SE_CD IN ('028', '029', '030', '035', '036') THEN D.CASE_MNG_NO END) AS PRTPNT_LINK /*연계*/ FROM SEB510 A /*서비스제공대상자*/ LEFT JOIN SDA100 B /*자원기본*/ ON A.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN SEB100 D /*사례기본*/ ON A.CASE_MNG_NO = D.CASE_MNG_NO AND A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = D.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN (SELECT BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO, BB.TRMN_CS_SE_CD, AA.CASE_TRMN_YMD, BB.TRMN_SE_CD, BB.YNGBGS_CHNG_LAST_RESULT_CN, AA.PIC_OPNN_CN ,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY BB.CASE_MNG_NO, BB.CASE_MNG_ODRNO ORDER BY BB.CASE_TRMN_NO DESC) AS RN FROM SEC100 AA /*사례종결 테이블*/ LEFT JOIN SEC100 BB ON BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.CASE_MNG_NO = AA.CASE_MNG_NO AND BB.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '01' /*종결심사결과구분코드(신청)*/ WHERE AA.TRMN_SRNG_RESULT_SE_CD = '02' /*종결심사결과구분코드(심사(승인))*/ )E ON E.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND E.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO AND E.RN=1 LEFT JOIN SDA420 K /*서비스실행사업*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = K.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SDA400 F /*서비스사업*/ ON F.SRVC_BIZ_NO = K.SRVC_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SAA000 G /*통합기관*/ ON B.RSFR_INST_NO = G.INST_NO LEFT JOIN AFA310 H /*학기관리*/ ON B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = H.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LEFT JOIN SEA200 I /*대상자정보*/ ON I.TRPR_INFO_NO = D.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 J /*개인식별번호*/ ON I.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = J.INDV_IDNTFC_NO
WHERE H.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND B.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND A.DEL_YN = 'N'
AND F.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND B.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND G.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND H.SEMSTR_SE_CD LIKE #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} || '%' AND G.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND B.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
GROUP BY B.RESRCE_NO , B.PVSN_RESRCE_NM , B.PVSN_BGNG_YMD , B.PVSN_END_YMD , B.UTZTN_PSNCPA_NOPE , F.BIZ_YR , K.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO , G.INST_NO , H.SEMSTR_SE_CD , K.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM , G.INST_NM , G.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD ORDER BY B.RESRCE_NO, H.SEMSTR_SE_CD

/* selectPrtpntTrgtPreconList(참여자대상별현황) - Lee Sang Hoon */ WITH SXDC AS( SELECT CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , CMMNS_CD_VALUE , 1 AS SRT , SRTNG_SQNCE , SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE2 FROM SAC100 WHERE CMMNS_CD_ID ='SXDC_SE_CD' ), ACBG AS ( SELECT * FROM SXDC UNION ALL SELECT X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE , 2 AS SRT , X.SRTNG_SQNCE , X.SRTNG_SQNCE2 FROM ( SELECT CONCAT(A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM,B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM) AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , CONCAT(A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE,B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE) AS CMMNS_CD_VALUE , A.SRTNG_SQNCE , B.SRTNG_SQNCE AS SRTNG_SQNCE2 FROM SAC100 A CROSS JOIN SAC100 B WHERE A.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' /*학력*/ AND B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD' /*졸업상태*/ AND A.CMMNS_CD_VALUE IN ('02','03','04','07','05','06') ) X WHERE X.CMMNS_CD_VALUE NOT LIKE '%99' )
SELECT T2.BIZ_YR AS BIZ_YR , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM AS SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM , T0.PVSN_RESRCE_NM AS PVSN_RESRCE_NM , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T0.PVSN_BGNG_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_BGNG_YMD , TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(T0.PVSN_END_YMD), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS PVSN_END_YMD , T3.INST_NM AS OPER_INST_NM , T3.INST_NO AS INST_NO , C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS SEMSTR_SE , C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE AS SEMSTR_SE_CD , CASE T.SRT WHEN 1 THEN '성별' WHEN 2 THEN '학력' END AS CL , T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM AS TOT_PRVSON , COUNT(T5.TRPR_INFO_NO) AS PTCPTN_NOPE , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM SEB510 WHERE RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO) AS TRPRNO FROM ACBG T CROSS JOIN SDA100 T0 INNER JOIN SDA420 T1 ON T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T0.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SDA400 T2 ON T2.SRVC_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_BIZ_NO INNER JOIN SAA000 T3 ON T3.INST_NO = T0.RSFR_INST_NO INNER JOIN AFA310 T4 ON T4.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND T4.USE_YN = 'Y' LEFT JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT B.RESRCE_NO , NVL(E.SXDC_SE_CD, C.SXDC_SE_CD) AS SXDC_SE_CD , D.ACBG_SE_CD || D.GRDTN_STTS_SE_CD AS ACBG_CD , C.TRPR_INFO_NO , G.SEMSTR_SE_CD FROM SEB100 A LEFT JOIN SEB530 B ON B.CASE_MNG_NO = A.CASE_MNG_NO AND B.CASE_MNG_ODRNO = A.CASE_MNG_ODRNO LEFT JOIN SEA200 C ON C.TRPR_INFO_NO = A.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN (SELECT A.* , ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY A.TRPR_INFO_NO ORDER BY B.ADDTNG_MNG_VALUE1 DESC, A.MNG_SN DESC) AS RN FROM SEA230 A LEFT JOIN SAC100 B ON B.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'ACBG_SE_CD' AND B.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = A.ACBG_SE_CD WHERE A.DEL_YN != 'Y' ) D ON D.RN = 1 AND D.TRPR_INFO_NO = C.TRPR_INFO_NO LEFT JOIN SCA300 E ON E.INDV_IDNTFC_NO = C.INDV_IDNTFC_NO LEFT JOIN SDA100 F ON F.RESRCE_NO = B.RESRCE_NO LEFT JOIN AFA310 G ON G.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO = F.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO AND G.USE_YN = 'Y' AND B.PTCPTN_YMD BETWEEN G.BGNG_YMD AND G.END_YMD WHERE A.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} ) T5 ON T5.RESRCE_NO = T0.RESRCE_NO AND T5.SEMSTR_SE_CD = T4.SEMSTR_SE_CD AND (T5.SXDC_SE_CD = T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE OR T5.ACBG_CD = T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE) LEFT JOIN SAC100 C1 ON C1.CMMNS_CD_ID = 'SEMSTR_SE_CD' AND C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE = T4.SEMSTR_SE_CD
WHERE 1=1 AND T0.APRV_STTS_SE_CD = '2' AND T0.SRVC_RESRCE_LCLAS_SE_CD <> '01' AND T3.UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD = #{UNT_TASKWK_SE_CD} AND T2.BIZ_YR LIKE #{BIZ_YR} || '%' AND T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO LIKE #{SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO} || '%' AND T3.INST_NO LIKE #{INST_NO} || '%' AND C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE LIKE #{SEMSTR_SE_CD} || '%' AND T0.RESRCE_NO LIKE #{RESRCE_NO} || '%'
GROUP BY T2.BIZ_YR, T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NM, T0.PVSN_RESRCE_NM, T0.PVSN_BGNG_YMD, T0.PVSN_END_YMD, T3.INST_NO, T3.INST_NM, T4.SEMSTR_SE_CD, T.SRT, T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM , T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO, T.SRTNG_SQNCE, T.SRTNG_SQNCE2, C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE_NM, C1.CMMNS_CD_VALUE, T0.RESRCE_NO, T.CMMNS_CD_VALUE
ORDER BY T1.SRVC_EXCN_BIZ_NO DESC, T0.PVSN_RESRCE_NM, T4.SEMSTR_SE_CD, T.SRT, T.SRTNG_SQNCE, T.SRTNG_SQNCE2
